On Instagram, they advertise themselves as "Japan's Kindest Pet Shop," so I went there hoping to find a pet I liked.
The man who's always in their Instagram photos was there, but his voice, tone, and manner of speaking were completely different from the videos on Instagram. I thought he was quite unpleasant.
I was served by a woman, so it wasn't the man from Instagram, but I overheard her checking with the man from Instagram because my question was difficult to answer, and that's when I got the impression.
I ended up saying to the girl I went with when we left the store, "His attitude is completely different, lol."
Also, the woman was far too slow to approach us. Other pet shops approach you right away, making the conversation much easier. Where's the "Japan's Kindest" part?
Furthermore, the woman said that this pet shop only brings in cute pets, so they sell out and are replaced quickly. I sensed something shady about that statement, lol. Where's the "Japan's Kindest" part?

Indeed, only cute girls like those on Instagram are there.

So, I might buy something here, hence the 3-star rating.

The guy on Instagram should probably think about his attitude when he's actually working in the store.

During Golden Week, I was pressured into buying a dog for 1.1 million yen.

They were incredibly pushy, saying things like, "There's no such thing as timing," and "It's okay." Even when I finally said, "I'll think about it until tomorrow," they persisted, saying things like, "If you can decide by tomorrow, you should decide now!" and "It might be gone tomorrow!"

I finally said, "I'll come back if I decide to adopt it by tomorrow morning," exchanged LINE contact information, and left the store.

Afterward, they sent me several photos of the dog via LINE, but it was very thin, and the price had been drastically reduced. It was such a plump puppy when I went to see it.
The first two photos are from when I first saw it, and the third is a photo they sent me.

The day I went to see it was its debut day or something, and about a week later, after Golden Week, the price was drastically reduced to 700,000 yen, and it continued to be lowered after that.

In a month and a half, it went from 1.1 million yen to 390,000 yen.

I'm not going to buy it just because it's cheap.

I feel so sorry for the dog. I hope they feed it plenty.
